Reservoir/Volume.desc: Stored volume above the dead storage at 380 m a.s.l.

River/Flow.desc: Total release to the river (units + spillway + bottom outlet)

Plant/MWSetpoint.desc: Plant MW setpoint from the grid operator (incl. AGC)

Plant/MWSetpointReachable.desc: False when the online units can't make the setpoint

Plant/AGCEnabled.desc: The grid operator's AGC adds small setpoint changes

Plant/GridFrequency.desc: Grid frequency at the 150 kV busbar

Intake/TrashRackDP.desc: Head loss across the trash rack (clogging)

Intake/RakerRunning.desc: Trash rack raker cleaning cycle active

Penstock/Pressure.desc: Penstock pressure at the powerhouse manifold

Spillway/Gate01/Mode.desc: AUTO (opens near 420 m a.s.l.) or MAN

Spillway/Gate02/Mode.desc: AUTO (opens near 420 m a.s.l.) or MAN

BottomOutlet/Mode.desc: AUTO (keeps the minimum river flow) or MAN
